faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Answers to common questions about using the nicchyo Sunday Market map and about the Kochi Sunday Market.
mapIntro.title: Welcome to the Sunday Market
mapIntro.lead: Every **Sunday**, a stretch of about **1.3 km** from the foot of Kochi Castle to Otesuji Street fills with around **300 stalls**.
mapIntro.welcome.label: Welcome
mapIntro.welcome.comment: Welcome to the Sunday Market! Let me give you a quick tour.
mapIntro.map.label: Find stalls on the map
mapIntro.map.comment: Photos of stalls will appear one by one. Tap one that catches your eye to take a look inside.
mapIntro.search.label: Filter by category
mapIntro.search.comment: Not sure what's here? Browse by category.
mapIntro.consult.label: Ask Nichiyo-san
mapIntro.consult.comment: Sometimes asking is quicker than searching. Ask me anything!
mapIntro.odekake.label: Outing support
mapIntro.odekake.comment: Looking for a restroom? Find it here. I'll guide you to the nearest one.
mapIntro.end.label: The end
mapIntro.end.comment: Well then, off you go. Have a lovely Sunday Market!
mapIntro.railHint: Drag me up or down and the tour moves along with you.
mapIntro.consultDemo.greeting: Ask me anything about this street.
mapIntro.consultDemo.1.a: If you want something to eat while you walk, try imoten (sweet potato tempura). It's handed to you fresh in a paper bag, so you can head straight to the next stall.
mapIntro.consultDemo.2.a: Of course. Start by walking straight down the middle of the street, and stop whenever a stall catches your eye.
mapIntro.consultDemo.3.a: There are a few along Otesuji Street. Tap "Outing support" and I'll guide you to the nearest one.
mapIntro.consultDemo.note: This is a sample conversation. The real Nichiyo-san answers based on the shops open that day.
